channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Phil Jackson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Phil Jackson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brian Scalabrine on Michael Jordan, Phil Jackson, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Scalabrine then talked about the advice that Jordan shared with Mazzulla in his hangouts with the two NBA legends.

“He [Mazzulla] told them at the partners' summit that he actually hung out with Michael Jordan and Phil Jackson this summer. And Jordan told Joe that 'the reason why I kept winning was I acted like I never won,'”

Brian Scalabrine on Michael Jordan, Phil Jackson, Joe Mazzulla, Sep 23, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Phil Jackson
item.description:
Tiago Splitter:

“I'm still learning. I'm still a young coach. I'm not saying I'm Phil Jackson. But I've gotten better as a coach for sure, from last summer.”

Tiago Splitter on Phil Jackson, Apr 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Randy Brown on Steve Kerr, Phil Jackson, Ron Harper, John Salley, Toni Kukoc, Jud Buechler, Luc Longley, Bill Wennington, Jason Caffey, Scott Burrell
item.description:
Randy Brown:

“It would be an honor for the Bulls fans to see Michael, Scottie and Dennis. Phil Jackson. Steve Kerr. Toni Kukoc, Ron Harper, Luc Longley, Bill Wennington, Jud Buechler, John Salley, Buddha Edwards, Scott Burrell, Jason Caffey. I had some great teammates along the way, and Bulls fans would love to acknowledge that this is a championship city.“I’m not going to let it go. I’m hoping it will happen sooner rather than later. Even though everyone’s read in the media about Michael and Scottie’s differences, all that stuff, I hope it can all come to fruition, that we can hug each other one last time. And then from there, we can see where it goes.”

Randy Brown on Steve Kerr, Phil Jackson, Ron Harper, John Salley, Toni Kukoc, Jud Buechler, Luc Longley, Bill Wennington, Jason Caffey, Scott Burrell, Dec 19, 2025. Source: ESportsBets.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Phil Jackson
item.description:
“I would tell him to pace himself. You know, Phil Jackson— and I don't know how he did it— but the three years we won in a row, he would come in at times and be like, 'Hey, sit these two games out. I need you to rest. No parties, no rap videos, no commercials—just rest. But when you come back, I need you to average 40.'”

Shaquille O'Neal on Phil Jackson, Nov 3, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Scottie Pippen on Phil Jackson
item.description:
Scottie Pippen:

“It’s never been on the top shelf, but that’s the nature of the business. I was like that with Phil Jackson, but we’re not tight anymore neither so it’s a part of life and the cycles that we go through.”

Scottie Pippen on Phil Jackson, Sep 26, 2025. Source: Marca.com.

item.title: Brian Shaw on Ron Harper, Phil Jackson
item.description:
Brian Shaw on Phil Jackson pulling him in Game 7 vs. Blazers in 2000:

“You know, there there's a clip I think when I I came out maybe two or three minutes left in the game and I looked over at him when Ron Harper came in the game for me and I looked at him like,”

Brian Shaw on Ron Harper, Phil Jackson, Sep 2, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Phil Jackson, JJ Redick, Pat Riley
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal:

“I was fortunate enough to play for coaches like Phil Jackson and Pat Riley. When you have coaches like that, you listen. When Phil Jackson tells you to run a play, you do it because you’ve seen him win six championships. You know he knows what he’s talking about. Butwhen you get a young coach who hasn’t won anything, there’s a different level of respect. You might think, 'I’m a better player than this guy ever was. Why should I listen to him?' That’s what I think the Lakers are going to face with JJ Redick. LeBron and AD will keep everyone in line, but I think it’s going to be tough for a young coach to get that level of respect from veteran players.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Phil Jackson, JJ Redick, Pat Riley, Sep 7, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Phil Jackson
item.description:
Recounting his feelings at the time, Anthony shared,

“When I left New York, I didn’t leave New York. I got pushed out of New York, Phil [Jackson] pushed me out of New York. I struggled to leave New York.”

Carmelo Anthony on Phil Jackson, Feb 15, 2024. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Phil Jackson
item.description:
“Phil Jackson used to talk about retiring from playing as a ‘death’ and tell us we had to prepare for the loss,”

Steve Kerr on Phil Jackson, Oct 22, 2021. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Michael Jordan, Phil Jackson
item.description:
To Reinsdorf, the revisionist history of the end of the dynasty is less so.

“I asked (coach) Phil (Jackson) to come back. Phil said no. Michael said I won’t play for anybody other than Phil,”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Michael Jordan, Phil Jackson, Jun 6, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Phil Jackson, Jerry Krause
item.description:
Michael Jordan:

“At the beginning of the season, it basically started when [Bulls general manager]Jerry Krause told Phil [Jackson] that he could go 82 and 0 and he would never get the chance to come back. Knowing that, I married myself to [Jackson], obviously, and if he wasn't going to be the coach, then I obviously wasn't going to play. So Phil started off the year saying, 'This is the last dance,' and we played it that way. Basically, it just kind of tugged at you through the course of the year, knowing that this had to come to an end. But it also centered our focus to make sure we ended it right.”

Michael Jordan on Phil Jackson, Jerry Krause, Apr 16, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Derek Fisher on Phil Jackson
item.description:
“I do believe that part of our struggle in New York was, 1) I didn’t find a way to communicate effectively that would allow for him to understand my vision and where I saw the team and where I saw us going. But also for me to understand his concerns and what he wanted to continue to see from me or things that were important to (Jackson),”

Derek Fisher on Phil Jackson, Nov 8, 2018. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Phil Jackson
item.description:
“I think the difference is with Phil [Jackson] in '98 we all were free agents and we all knew we were all going to be gone, including Phil,”

Steve Kerr on Phil Jackson, Sep 25, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Phil Jackson, John Paxson
item.description:
Here’s the MJ story Kerr told Durant:

“When MJ was with the Bulls, they had a playoff game. He kept trying to score and he was scoring, but they weren’t getting anything going. Phil Jackson said, ‘Who’s open?’ He said, ‘John Paxson.’I want you to trust your teammates early. What you’re doing is you’re getting to the rim and then you’re trying to hit them. I want you to trust the first guy and then move. Still attack, still look to score, but trust these guys, OK?”

Steve Kerr on Phil Jackson, John Paxson, Jun 2, 2018. Source: For The Win.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Phil Jackson
item.description:
Pau Gasol:

“Pop and Phil Jackson are the greatest basketball coaches of the last 20 or 30 years.”

Pau Gasol on Phil Jackson, Mar 24, 2018. Source: La Nacion.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Phil Jackson, Tex Winter
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Kobe Bryant on new ESPN show (2/2):

“I learned how to study film from the best coaches of all time – Phil Jackson and Tex Winter. Detail provides an opportunity to teach that skill to the next generation on large platform with ESPN.”

Kobe Bryant on Phil Jackson, Tex Winter, Jan 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Luke Walton on Phil Jackson, Kurt Rambis
item.description:
“Not only (because of Jackson) but I played under Kurt Rambis for a lot of years, and there's people out here that I wanted to see succeed. I love the triangle offense. I wanted to see that work. But for whatever reasons it didn't.”

Luke Walton on Phil Jackson, Kurt Rambis, Dec 12, 2017. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Chris Brickley on Phil Jackson
item.description:
“So I go in, I'm super nervous, super scared. It's Phil Jackson. I don't even know the guy. I come in sit down in his office and he said, 'I'm gonna ask you three questions.”

Chris Brickley on Phil Jackson, Aug 4, 2017. Source: businessinsider.com.

item.title: Frank Ntilikina on Phil Jackson
item.description:
“This is the system that brings him [Jackson] a lot of championships, definitely. The system that I played back in France with my team is quite similar with it. I think I can definitely fit the system.”

Frank Ntilikina on Phil Jackson, Jun 24, 2017. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Phil Jackson, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Brian Robb:Danny Ainge on Phil Jackson/Porzingis rumors:

“I think Phil is a pretty bright guy and knows what he's doing.”

Danny Ainge on Phil Jackson, Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @CelticsHub.

item.title: Adam Silver on Carmelo Anthony, Phil Jackson
item.description:
“We did not consider disciplining Phil Jackson for those comments about potentially trading Carmelo,”

Adam Silver on Carmelo Anthony, Phil Jackson, Jun 2, 2017. Source: RealGM.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Phil Jackson
item.description:
“[Management] will look at that.[General manager] Steve [Mills] and [president] Phil [Jackson] and those guys will look at whatever can help us out. We know we need some help there.”

Jeff Hornacek on Phil Jackson, Mar 28, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Phil Jackson, Steve Mills
item.description:
Hornacek said.

“If we think that we can somehow -- with a fresh start of training camp and go to it right off the bat, if that helps us and Phil [Jackson] and Steve [Mills] -- we think maybe the same guys on this team could have a different outlook on it, then we'll stay the same. If not, they'll look at other guys.”

Jeff Hornacek on Phil Jackson, Steve Mills, Mar 22, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tracy McGrady on Phil Jackson
item.description:
Tracy McGrady:

“I think it affects (the Knicks) in free agency. Not only in that situation but all the things that have accumulated over this season. Phil Jackson going at Melo publicly. Like, what are you doing? You’re supposed to be on the same team. Like you’re supposed to be encouraging your brother and giving him some of you expertise and helping him become a better player. And it’s just an unfortunate situation. I feel bad for Melo. But he’s handled it so well. Me in that situation? It probably would be a different story.”

Tracy McGrady on Phil Jackson, Feb 18, 2017. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: James Dolan on Phil Jackson
item.description:
Dolan on Phil Jackson:

“Whether I like the results or don't like the results,I am going to honor that (contract) until the end.”

James Dolan on Phil Jackson, Feb 10, 2017. Source: Twitter @AdiJoseph.

item.title: Luke Walton on Phil Jackson
item.description:
Bill Oram:Luke Walton on Phil Jackson:

“He's been saying stuff to get people upsetbever since I've known him.”

Luke Walton on Phil Jackson, Dec 11, 2016. Source: Twitter @billoram.

item.title: Reggie Miller on LeBron James, Phil Jackson
item.description:
“And LeBron James built not only a sports empire but a business empire with Rich Paul and Maverick Carter, and it just so happens to be guys he grew up with. When you use the term posse, most people are going to think it's African American, which pretty much it is. If you're Phil Jackson, you wouldn't say Tom Brady has a posse, or Aaron Rodgers has a posse. So why does LeBron James have to have a posse if it's his friends that work for him and built up this empire? To me it's Phil Jackson is out of touch. I thought it was uncalled for.”

Reggie Miller on LeBron James, Phil Jackson, Nov 18, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Phil Jackson
item.description:
Hornacek seemed annoyed with the subject before Tuesday's game against the Pistons.

“(Jackson's) just kind of reiterating things that we've talked about with guys about. Guys like listening to what he has to say,”

Jeff Hornacek on Phil Jackson, Nov 2, 2016. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Phil Jackson, Joakim Noah
item.description:
Rose said he maintained a workout regimen while on trial in L.A., and was eased mentally by the support from the Knicks.

“I was talking to them along the way, every day, talking to if not Phil (Jackson), Steve (Mills), Joakim, some of the other players that reached out,”

Derrick Rose on Phil Jackson, Joakim Noah, Oct 22, 2016. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Willy Hernangomez on Phil Jackson
item.description:
Before signing his first NBA contract last month, the 6-foot-11 Hernangomez was introduced to the Knicks president.

“When I met him, I was very excited because it’s Phil Jackson,”

Willy Hernangomez on Phil Jackson, Aug 4, 2016. Source: New York Post.
